title.fr: Champ électrique créé par une charge ponctuelle

sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas with a single source charge Q at center. Canvas2D
overlay renders the radial E-field as a sparse array of arrows (or a
heatmap of |E|) using E = k·Q/r² · r̂. Draggable test point M shows
the local E vector arrow plus HUD readout of |E| (V/m) and r. Student
drags M and adjusts Q via a slider (with sign toggle). Experiment:
hit target |E| at a marked point M by choosing Q and r together.
Evaluate: hide the arrow overlay; only a target marker and target |E|
shown — student picks Q so |E(M)| = target within tolerance. Wrinkle:
Q in nC, distances in cm to make |E| land in kV/m.
